packet.title: Schematron: predeclared prefixes, findings in other documents, real schemas read with warnings (implementation, book)

body.p: After , , and book-30. Three changes the owner asked for on 2026-10-29, in this order, in the same files.

item.p: Prefixes (the orchestrator's research of ISO/IEC 19757-3:2025): 5.4.10 says prefixes in query expressions are defined by ns, but every binding annex adds that "all namespaces, prefixes, functions and operators defined by" the function library (XPath2Functions, XPath3Functions; F&O) "shall be available" (Annexes C, H to L for the XPath and XSLT bindings). sxml requires ns even for fn, xs, math, , and err. Make those prefixes available without ns in every query expression of the schema, the foreign XSLT elements' expressions included (xml always bound); an ns element may bind any prefix, these included, and then wins; other prefixes still need ns. Record the reading with its clauses in a D-record, adjust 's wording, add cases to the 7.30 suite (neutral: these prefixes resolve without ns), and fix the book's sentence that says otherwise.

Findings in other documents (found by book-30): a pattern with documents reports its findings with the validated file's name and the other document's lines, and the JSON report does not say which document a finding is in. Every finding names its document (the resolved URI, shown relative to the working directory as the command shows files) in text, JSON and SVRL (D.2's subordinate document), in the C report (sxml_schematron_report: if a field is needed, it is an additive header change, recorded) and in the JavaScript API; lines and columns are that document's. Tests, and the book's example in schematron-documents.md shows it.

Real schemas read with warnings (the owner's decision on 's Proposed entry: option a): the known deviations of real rule sets are accepted by default and each occurrence is reported as a warning through the compile report sink, naming its clause: a parameter named twice in one instance (the first wins; 5.4.11, Annex B); a pattern's let read by other patterns (pattern lets visible schema-wide; 3.23); let after assertions in a rule (Annex A's order). The undeclared xs in a foreign xsl:function is no deviation after change 1. Warnings do not change the exit status; --format=json lists them. The compatibility does not hide real errors: anything else stays an error. The 7.30 suite's cases for those three become deviations on 7.28's list (they are errors by the standard), with this record's reason. Then EN 16931 CII and XRechnung UBL and CII compile from their sources: gate 1 (CII 9 of 9) and gate 3 (the differential against SchXslt on the unpatched sources) of 7.28 run in ctest. The book's reports chapter shows a warning from a small schema written for the book (no third-party rule sets in the book).

Owns: src/schematron*, include/sxml/schematron.h (additive), apps/sxml/command_validate.c, the JavaScript binding's Schematron API, tests/schematron*, tests/cli/, the Schematron chapters of docs/book/.

Done when: each change tested; the 7.30 suite passes every applicable case except the deviation list; EN 16931 UBL 1,133 of 1,133 and CII 9 of 9 from the sources; the differential identical on unpatched EN 16931 and XRechnung; the book's examples match and the book builds; a D-record with the three decisions; XT40 whole, base and change in the same setup, if shared XSLT files change. Done 2026-10-29 (): (1) the function library's prefixes in every query and foreign XSLT declaration, ns wins; suite cases ns-predeclared-*, rules-predeclared-xs-prefix normative. (2) sxml_schematron_report.document_uri (additive); text, JSON (document), host shim and package; the book's api.sch gains a pattern over vane-api.xsd. (3) schematron:compatibility warnings for a parameter twice in an instance, a pattern let read elsewhere, a rule let after assertions; JSON schematron.warnings, Schematron.warnings; three suite deviations. Suite 520: 467 pass, 6 deviations; EN 16931 UBL 1,133/1,133, CII 9/9; differential identical on the unpatched EN 16931 and XRechnung (ctest with SXML_SCHEMATRON_DIFFERENTIAL). No shared XSLT file changed (no XT40 run). sxml.wasm not built here (no WASI SDK); the package typechecks.
